property_summary: For any admissible call (exactly 10 ether, on a timestamp strictly after pastBlockTime), the reference pays out its entire balance whenever block.number % 15 == 0, leaving address(c).balance == 0; the mutant (condition inverted) never pays on such blocks, so its balance stays nonzero.
change_summary: Change the payout condition from `block.number % 15 == 0` to `block.number % 15 != 0`, inverting when the contract pays out.
